label: BACKTEST (walk-forward, Wayback-archived public list prices)

sources.lambda: web.archive.org snapshots of lambdalabs.com/service/gpu-cloud, lambda.ai/service/gpu-cloud, lambda.ai/pricing

model: Damped Holt (phi .9) on weekly log list price; 80% interval = walk-forward empirical residual quantiles (min 8 past residuals, else ±8%·sqrt(h/7))
